meals.name: High-Carb Honey Nut Oatmeal Bowl
meals.description: A dense, high-carbohydrate breakfast bowl packed with oats, whole milk, sliced banana, peanut butter, and honey to fuel your morning.
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine rolled oats and whole milk over medium heat.
Simmer for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally until oats are tender and thick.
Transfer cooked oatmeal into a serving bowl.
Top with sliced banana, swirl in peanut butter, and drizzle honey over the top before serving.

meals.name: Chicken & Sweet Potato Rice Bowl
meals.description: A wholesome calorie-dense lunch featuring lean chicken breast, fluffy jasmine rice, roasted sweet potatoes, and steamed broccoli.
ingredients: Salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Toss sweet potato cubes in half the olive oil, salt, and pepper; roast for 25 minutes until tender.
Heat remaining olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Season diced chicken breast with garlic powder, salt, and pepper, then cook for 6-8 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Steam broccoli florets until bright green and tender-crisp.
Assemble bowl by layering jasmine rice, roasted sweet potatoes, steamed broccoli, and cooked chicken.

meals.name: Peanut Butter & Banana Toast
meals.description: A fast and effective high-carb snack composed of whole wheat toast spread with peanut butter, banana slices, and a dash of honey.
instructions: Toast the whole wheat bread slices until golden brown.
Evenly spread 1 tablespoon of peanut butter onto each toast slice.
Arrange banana slices on top of the peanut butter.
Drizzle lightly with honey and serve immediately.

meals.name: Turkey & Pasta Marinara
meals.description: A hearty dinner containing penne pasta tossed with seasoned lean ground turkey, savory marinara sauce, olive oil, and parmesan.
ingredients: Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook penne according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a pan over medium heat, heat olive oil and add ground turkey. Season with Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper, cooking until browned.
Pour marinara sauce into the pan with turkey and let simmer for 3 minutes.
Combine cooked pasta with turkey marinara sauce, sprinkle with parmesan cheese, and serve warm.

meals.name: Granola & Berry Yogurt Parfait
meals.description: A nutrient-rich evening snack or dessert combining Greek yogurt, crunchy granola, raisins, and maple syrup.
instructions: In a glass or bowl, layer half of the Greek yogurt at the bottom.
Add a layer of granola and dried raisins/cranberries.
Top with remaining Greek yogurt, remaining granola, and finish with a drizzle of maple syrup.
